import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
from markdownify import markdownify as md
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import re

async def get_arxiv_ml_papers_last_30_days():
    """
    获取arXiv上标题包含'machine learning'的论文在过去30天（不包含今天）的数量
    """
    url = "https://arxiv.org/search/advanced"
    
    # 获取当前真实时间并计算过去30天的日期范围（不包含今天）
    now = datetime.now()
    print(f"当前时间: {now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')}")
    
    # 过去30天不包含今天：从31天前到昨天
    end_date = now - timedelta(days=1)  # 昨天
    start_date = now - timedelta(days=30)  # 30天前（不包含今天，所以是31天前到昨天，共30天）
    
    start_date_str = start_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    end_date_str = end_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    
    print(f"🗓️ 搜索日期范围: {start_date_str} 到 {end_date_str} (过去30天，不包含今天)")
    print(f"   开始日期: {start_date.strftime('%Y年%m月%d日')}")
    print(f"   结束日期: {end_date.strftime('%Y年%m月%d日')}")
    
    # 验证日期范围天数
    days_diff = (end_date - start_date).days + 1
    print(f"   总天数: {days_diff} 天")
    
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        page = await browser.new_page()
        await page.goto(url, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=60000)
        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
        
        print("🔍 正在设置搜索条件...")
        
        # 设置搜索字段为标题
        field_select = page.locator("select[name='terms-0-field']")
        await field_select.select_option("title")
        print("✅ 已选择搜索字段为标题")
        
        # 输入搜索关键词
        term_input = page.locator("input[name='terms-0-term']")
        await term_input.fill("machine learning")
        print("✅ 已输入搜索关键词: machine learning")
        
        # 设置日期筛选
        # 选择按日期范围筛选
        date_range_radio = page.locator("input[id='date-filter_by-3']")
        await date_range_radio.check()
        print("✅ 已选择按日期范围筛选")
        
        # 设置开始日期
        from_date_input = page.locator("input[name='date-from_date']")
        await from_date_input.fill(start_date_str)
        print(f"✅ 已设置开始日期: {start_date_str}")
        
        # 设置结束日期
        to_date_input = page.locator("input[name='date-to_date']")
        await to_date_input.fill(end_date_str)
        print(f"✅ 已设置结束日期: {end_date_str}")
        
        # 设置结果数量为最大
        size_select = page.locator("select[name='size']")
        await size_select.select_option("200")
        print("✅ 已设置每页显示200个结果")
        
        # 执行搜索
        search_button = page.locator("button.is-link.is-medium").last
        await search_button.click()
        print("🔍 正在执行搜索...")
        
        # 等待搜索结果加载
        await page.wait_for_timeout(5000)
        
        # 获取当前页面URL以确认搜索已执行
        current_url = page.url
        print(f"当前页面URL: {current_url}")
        
        # 获取搜索结果数量
        total_results = 0
        
        # 查找结果统计信息
        result_stats = page.locator("h1, .search-info, .results-info")
        if await result_stats.count() > 0:
            for i in range(await result_stats.count()):
                text = await result_stats.nth(i).inner_text()
                print(f"结果信息 {i+1}: {text}")
                
                # 从文本中提取总结果数
                # 常见格式: "Showing 1–25 of 1,234 results"
                match = re.search(r'of\s+([\d,]+)\s+results?', text, re.IGNORECASE)
                if match:
                    total_results = int(match.group(1).replace(',', ''))
                    print(f"找到总结果数: {total_results}")
                    break
                
                # 另一种格式: "1,234 results"
                match = re.search(r'([\d,]+)\s+results?', text, re.IGNORECASE)
                if match:
                    total_results = int(match.group(1).replace(',', ''))
                    print(f"找到总结果数: {total_results}")
                    break
        
        # 如果没有找到统计信息，计算当前页面的论文数量
        if total_results == 0:
            articles = page.locator("li.arxiv-result, .arxiv-result")
            article_count = await articles.count()
            print(f"当前页面找到 {article_count} 篇论文")
            
            # 检查是否有"No results found"之类的信息
            page_content = await page.content()
            if "No results" in page_content or "0 results" in page_content:
                total_results = 0
            else:
                total_results = article_count
        
        await browser.close()
        
        answer = f"arXiv上标题包含'machine learning'的论文在过去30天（不包含今天，即{start_date_str}到{end_date_str}）共有 {total_results} 篇。"
        return answer

# 执行主函数
async def main():
    result = await get_arxiv_ml_papers_last_30_days()
    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("🎉 最终答案:")
    print("="*60)
    print(result)
    return result

result = asyncio.run(main())
print(f"返回结果: {result}")

import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
from markdownify import markdownify as md
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import re

async def get_energy_indices_advantage():
    """
    获取上上个月全国电力供应系列指数中非化石能源发电综合指数相比化石能源发电综合指数的优势幅度
    """
    url = "https://www.cec.org.cn/menu/index.html?216"
    
    # 计算上上个月
    now = datetime.now()
    target_month = now.month - 2
    target_year = now.year
    if target_month <= 0:
        target_month += 12
        target_year -= 1
    
    print(f"🗓️ 当前时间: {now.strftime('%Y年%m月')}")
    print(f"🎯 目标查询月份: {target_year}年{target_month}月")
    
    # 初始化变量
    non_fossil_index = None
    fossil_index = None
    
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        page = await browser.new_page()
        await page.goto(url, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=60000)
        await page.wait_for_timeout(5000)
        
        print("📊 正在查找电力供应指数报告链接...")
        
        # 查找目标月份的CNESI报告链接
        cnesi_url = None
        
        links = await page.locator("a").all()
        
        for link in links:
            link_text = await link.inner_text()
            href = await link.get_attribute("href")
            
            # 匹配目标月份的CNESI报告
            if f"{target_year}年{target_month}月" in link_text and "CNESI" in link_text:
                cnesi_url = f"https://www.cec.org.cn{href.replace('..', '')}"
                print(f"找到CNESI报告: {link_text}")
                break
        
        # 访问CNESI报告页面
        if cnesi_url:
            print(f"🔍 正在访问CNESI报告页面...")
            await page.goto(cnesi_url, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=60000)
            await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
            
            page_text = await page.locator("body").inner_text()
            
            # 查找非化石能源发电综合指数
            pattern1 = r'非化石能源发电综合指数为(\d+\.?\d*)'
            match1 = re.search(pattern1, page_text)
            if match1:
                non_fossil_index = float(match1.group(1))
                print(f"✅ 非化石能源发电综合指数: {non_fossil_index}")
            
            # 查找化石能源发电综合指数
            pattern2 = r'(?<!非)化石能源发电综合指数为(\d+\.?\d*)'
            match2 = re.search(pattern2, page_text)
            if match2:
                fossil_index = float(match2.group(1))
                print(f"✅ 化石能源发电综合指数: {fossil_index}")
        
        await browser.close()
        
        # 生成答案
        if non_fossil_index is not None and fossil_index is not None:
            advantage = non_fossil_index - fossil_index
            percentage_advantage = (advantage / fossil_index) * 100
            ratio = non_fossil_index / fossil_index
            
            if advantage > 0:
                comparison_text = "领先"
                advantage_desc = f"非化石能源发电综合指数领先化石能源发电综合指数"
            else:
                comparison_text = "落后"
                advantage_desc = f"非化石能源发电综合指数落后于化石能源发电综合指数"
                advantage = abs(advantage)
                percentage_advantage = abs(percentage_advantage)
            
            answer = f"""**{target_year}年{target_month}月电力供应指数对比分析：**

 **非化石能源发电综合指数**: {non_fossil_index}
 **化石能源发电综合指数**: {fossil_index}
 **优势幅度**: {advantage:.1f}个点 ({comparison_text})
 **相对优势**: {percentage_advantage:.1f}%
 **倍数关系**: {ratio:.3f}倍

**结论**: {advantage_desc}{advantage:.1f}个点，相对优势为{percentage_advantage:.1f}%。"""
            
            return answer
        elif non_fossil_index is not None:
            return f"仅找到{target_year}年{target_month}月非化石能源发电综合指数: {non_fossil_index}，未找到化石能源发电综合指数数据。"
        elif fossil_index is not None:

L1_问题: 根据中国国家地震科学数据中心的数据，昨天有没有地震记录？

import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
from markdownify import markdownify as md
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import re
from typing import List, Dict, Optional

async def fetch_latest_earthquake_html() -> Optional[str]:
    """
    获取最新地震信息的HTML内容
    """
    url = "https://data.earthquake.cn/datashare/report.shtml?PAGEID=zxdzall"
    
    print(f"🚀 正在访问最新地震信息网站: {url}")
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        page = await browser.new_page()
        await page.goto(url, wait_until="load")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(5000)  # 等待数据加载
        
        # 查找包含地震数据的表格
        earthquake_table = page.locator("table").filter(has_text="震级")
        if await earthquake_table.count() > 0:
            print("✅ 找到地震数据表格")
            html_content = await earthquake_table.first.inner_html()
            await browser.close()
            return html_content
        
        await browser.close()
        return None

def parse_earthquake_data(html_content):
    markdown_text = md(html_content)
    lines = [line.strip() for line in markdown_text.split('\n') if line.strip()]
    earthquakes = []
    
    # 查找包含所有数据的那一行
    for line in lines:
        if '|' in line and '序号' in line and '发震时刻' in line:
            # 分割表格列
            parts = [part.strip() for part in line.split('|') if part.strip()]
            
            # 找到表头位置
            try:
                header_start = parts.index('序号')
                header = parts[header_start:header_start + 7]  # 7列表头
                
                # 从表头后开始解析数据
                data_start = header_start + 7
                
                # 每7列为一条记录
                i = data_start
                while i + 6 < len(parts):
                    try:
                        sequence = parts[i]
                        time_str = parts[i + 1]
                        longitude = float(parts[i + 2])
                        latitude = float(parts[i + 3])
                        depth = int(parts[i + 4])
                        magnitude = float(parts[i + 5])
                        location = parts[i + 6]
                        
                        # 验证是否为有效的地震数据行
                        if re.search(r'\d{4}-\d{1,2}-\d{1,2}\s+\d{1,2}:\d{2}:\d{2}', time_str):
                            # 清理地点信息中的链接格式
                            location = re.sub(r'\[([^\]]+)\].*', r'\1', location)
                            
                            earthquake = {
                                'sequence': sequence,
                                'time': time_str,
                                'longitude': longitude,
                                'latitude': latitude,
                                'depth': depth,
                                'magnitude': magnitude,
                                'location': location
                            }
                            earthquakes.append(earthquake)
                            print(f"   - 解析地震: {earthquake['time']} {earthquake['location']} M{earthquake['magnitude']}")
                    
                    except (ValueError, IndexError) as e:
                        pass  # 跳过无效数据
                    
                    i += 7  # 移动到下一条记录
                    
                break  # 找到数据后退出循环
                
            except ValueError:
                continue
    
    print(f"总共解析到 {len(earthquakes)} 条地震记录")
    return earthquakes

def check_yesterday_earthquakes(earthquakes: List[Dict]) -> Dict:
    """
    检查昨天是否有地震记录
    """
    print("🔍 正在检查昨天的地震记录...")
    
    # 获取昨天的日期
    yesterday = datetime.now() - timedelta(days=1)
    yesterday_date = yesterday.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    
    yesterday_earthquakes = []
    
    for eq in earthquakes:
        if yesterday_date in eq['time']:
            yesterday_earthquakes.append(eq)
    
    result = {
        'date': yesterday_date,
        'count': len(yesterday_earthquakes),
        'earthquakes': yesterday_earthquakes
    }
    
    print(f"   - 昨天({yesterday_date})共发生 {len(yesterday_earthquakes)} 次地震")
    
    return result

async def get_yesterday_earthquake_answer():
    """
    获取昨天地震情况的答案
    """
    # 步骤1: 获取HTML数据
    html_content = await fetch_latest_earthquake_html()
    
    # 步骤2: 解析地震数据
    earthquakes = parse_earthquake_data(html_content)
    
    # 步骤3: 检查昨天的地震情况
    yesterday_result = check_yesterday_earthquakes(earthquakes)
    
    # 步骤4: 生成答案
    print("\n" + "="*50)
    print("🎉 最终答案:")
    print("="*50 + "\n")
    
    if yesterday_result['count'] > 0:
        answer = f"根据国家地震科学数据中心的最新数据，昨天({yesterday_result['date']})共记录到 **{yesterday_result['count']} 次地震**：\n\n"
        
        for i, eq in enumerate(yesterday_result['earthquakes'], 1):
            answer += f"{i}. **{eq['time']}** - {eq['location']} - 震级M{eq['magnitude']} - 深度{eq['depth']}千米\n"
    else:
        answer = f"根据国家地震科学数据中心的最新数据，昨天({yesterday_result['date']}) **没有记录到地震**。"
    
    print(answer)
    return answer

# 直接运行异步函数
async def main():
    result = await get_yesterday_earthquake_answer()
    print(f"返回结果: {result}")
    return result

asyncio.run(main())

async def get_recent_forex_trends():
    """
    获取外汇市场发布的最近三个汇市观察美元指数的变化趋势
    """
    url = "https://www.boc.cn/fimarkets/foreignx/"
    
    print(f"🏦 正在访问中国银行外汇市场分析页面...")
    
    # 获取当前日期
    now = datetime.now()
    print(f"当前日期: {now.strftime('%Y年%m月%d日')}")
    
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        page = await browser.new_page()
        await page.goto(url, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=60000)
        await page.wait_for_timeout(5000)
        
        print("📊 正在查找最近的汇市观察文章...")
        
        # 查找所有包含"汇市观察"的链接
        links = await page.locator("a").all()
        forex_links = []
        
        for link in links:
            href = await link.get_attribute("href")
            text = await link.inner_text()
            
            if href and "汇市观察" in text and "202" in href:
                forex_links.append({
                    "text": text.strip(),
                    "href": href,
                    "date": text.strip()
                })
        
        print(f"找到 {len(forex_links)} 个汇市观察文章")
        
        if not forex_links:
            await browser.close()
            return "未找到汇市观察文章"
        
        # 取最近3篇文章
        recent_articles = forex_links[:3]
        print(f"分析最近3篇文章:")
        for i, article in enumerate(recent_articles):
            print(f"  {i+1}. {article['text']}")
        
        # 获取每篇文章的美元指数数据
        usd_index_data = []
        
        for article in recent_articles:
            print(f"正在获取文章: {article['text']}")
            
            # 构建完整URL
            if article['href'].startswith('./'):
                article_url = url + article['href'][2:]
            elif article['href'].startswith('/'):
                article_url = "https://www.boc.cn" + article['href']
            else:
                article_url = article['href']
            
            # 访问具体文章页面
            await page.goto(article_url, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=60000)
            await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)
            
            # 获取文章内容
            content_element = page.locator(".content").first
            if await content_element.count() > 0:
                article_content = await content_element.inner_text()
            else:
                article_content = await page.locator("body").inner_text()
            
            # 解析文章内容，提取美元指数数据
            lines = article_content.split('\n')
            title = ""
            date = ""
            usd_index = ""
            usd_change = ""
            
            for line in lines:
                line = line.strip()
                if not line:
                    continue
                    
                if "汇市观察" in line and "年" in line:
                    title = line
                    # 提取日期
                    date_match = re.search(r'(\d{4}年\d{1,2}月\d{1,2}日)', line)
                    if date_match:
                        date = date_match.group(1)
                
                # 查找美元指数数据
                if "美元指数" in line:
                    # 提取美元指数数值和变化
                    usd_match = re.search(r'美元指数收于([\d.]+).*?(上涨|下跌)([\d.]+)%', line)
                    if usd_match:
                        usd_index = usd_match.group(1)
                        change_direction = usd_match.group(2)
                        change_percent = usd_match.group(3)
                        usd_change = f"{change_direction}{change_percent}%"
                        break
            
            usd_index_data.append({
                "title": title,
                "date": date,
                "usd_index": usd_index,
                "usd_change": usd_change
            })
        
        await browser.close()
        
        # 分析趋势
        answer = f"根据中国银行外汇市场发布的最近三个汇市观察，美元指数的变化趋势：\n\n"
        
        for i, data in enumerate(usd_index_data, 1):
            answer += f"## {i}. {data['title']}\n"
            answer += f"**日期**: {data['date']}\n"
            answer += f"**美元指数**: {data['usd_index']}\n"
            answer += f"**变化**: {data['usd_change']}\n\n"
        
        # 计算总体趋势
        if len(usd_index_data) >= 2:
            try:
                latest_index = float(usd_index_data[0]['usd_index']) if usd_index_data[0]['usd_index'] else 0
                earliest_index = float(usd_index_data[-1]['usd_index']) if usd_index_data[-1]['usd_index'] else 0
                
                if latest_index > 0 and earliest_index > 0:
                    total_change = latest_index - earliest_index
                    total_change_percent = (total_change / earliest_index) * 100
                    
                    trend_direction = "上涨" if total_change > 0 else "下跌"
                    answer += f"## **总体趋势分析**\n"
                    answer += f"从 {usd_index_data[-1]['date']} 到 {usd_index_data[0]['date']}，美元指数从 {earliest_index} 变化到 {latest_index}，"
                    answer += f"总体{trend_direction} {abs(total_change):.2f} 点（{abs(total_change_percent):.2f}%）。\n\n"
            except:
                pass
        
        return answer

# 直接运行异步函数
async def main():
    result = await get_recent_forex_trends()
    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("最终答案:")
    print("="*60)
    print(result)
    return result

# 执行主函数
result = asyncio.run(main())
print(f"返回结果: {result}")

import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
from markdownify import markdownify as md
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import re

async def get_solar_eclipses_next_6_months():
    """
    获取从上海观测，未来半年内的日蚀信息
    """
    url = "https://www.heavens-above.com/SolarEclipses.aspx?lat=31.2313&lng=121.47&loc=%e4%b8%8a%e6%b5%b7%e5%b8%82&alt=0&tz=ChST"
    
    print(f"🌒 正在访问日蚀信息页面...")
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        page = await browser.new_page()
        await page.goto(url, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=60000)
        await page.wait_for_timeout(5000)
        
        print("📊 正在获取页面内容...")
        # 获取页面主要文本内容
        main_content = await page.locator("body").inner_text()
        
        await browser.close()
        
        # 解析日蚀信息
        eclipse_info = parse_eclipse_data(main_content)
        print(f"解析到 {len(eclipse_info)} 条日蚀信息")
        
        # 计算未来半年的日期范围
        now = datetime.now()
        six_months_later = now + timedelta(days=180)
        
        print(f"🗓️ 当前日期: {now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}")
        print(f"🗓️ 半年后日期: {six_months_later.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}")
        
        # 筛选未来半年的日蚀
        future_eclipses = []
        for eclipse in eclipse_info:
            eclipse_date = eclipse.get('date')
            if eclipse_date and now <= eclipse_date <= six_months_later:
                future_eclipses.append(eclipse)
                print(f"匹配到从上海观测，未来半年的日蚀: {eclipse_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')} ({eclipse['type']})")
        
        print(f"从上海观测，未来半年共有 {len(future_eclipses)} 次日蚀")
        
        # 生成答案
        if future_eclipses:
            answer = f"根据heavens-above官网的信息，从上海观测，未来半年内有 {len(future_eclipses)} 次日蚀：\n\n"
            for i, eclipse in enumerate(future_eclipses, 1):
                answer += f"{i}. **{eclipse['date'].strftime('%Y年%m月%d日')}** - {eclipse['type']}日蚀\n"
        else:
            answer = "根据heavens-above官网的信息，从上海观测，未来半年内没有日蚀。"
        
        return answer

def parse_eclipse_data(content):
    """
    解析日蚀数据
    """
    print("🔍 正在解析日蚀数据...")
    eclipses = []
    
    # 查找日蚀信息的模式：日期/月份/年份, 类型
    pattern = r'(\d{2})/(\d{2})/(\d{4}),\s*(Partial|Annular|Total)'
    matches = re.findall(pattern, content)
    
    for match in matches:
        day, month, year, eclipse_type = match
        try:
            eclipse_date = datetime(int(year), int(month), int(day))
            eclipse_info = {
                'date': eclipse_date,
                'type': eclipse_type
            }
            eclipses.append(eclipse_info)
            print(f"   解析到日蚀: {eclipse_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')} ({eclipse_type})")
        except ValueError:
            print(f"   跳过无效日期: {day}/{month}/{year}")
    
    return eclipses

# 直接运行异步函数
async def main():
    result = await get_solar_eclipses_next_6_months()
    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("🎉 最终答案:")
    print("="*60)
    print(result)
    return result

# 执行主函数
result = asyncio.run(main())
print(f"返回结果: {result}")

from markdownify import markdownify as md

async def get_power_indices_comparison():

    获取上上个月全国新能源发电综合指数和充换电服务业用电指数的数值及其差值

import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
from markdownify import markdownify as md
from datetime import datetime
import re

async def get_three_day_space_weather_forecast():
    """
    获取未来三天的空间天气预报中，太阳活动、地磁活动和电离层天气的具体情况
    """
    url = "http://www.nsmc.org.cn/NSMC/spaceweather/cn/sws/index.html"
    
    print(f"🌌 正在访问国家空间天气监测预警中心...")
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        page = await browser.new_page()
        
        # 设置用户代理
        await page.set_extra_http_headers({
            "User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/91.0.4472.124 Safari/537.36"
        })
        
        await page.goto(url, wait_until="networkidle", timeout=120000)
        await page.wait_for_timeout(10000)
        
        print("📊 正在获取未来三天空间天气预报...")
        
        # 获取页面文本内容
        body_text = await page.locator("body").inner_text()
        
        # 查找未来三天预报部分
        forecast_pattern = r'未来三天空间天气预报\s*(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\s+\d{2}:\d{2})\s*(.*?)(?=过去24小时|$)'
        forecast_match = re.search(forecast_pattern, body_text, re.DOTALL)
        
        if forecast_match:
            forecast_time = forecast_match.group(1)
            forecast_content = forecast_match.group(2).strip()
            
            print(f"预报发布时间: {forecast_time}")
            print("预报内容解析中...")
            
            # 解析预报内容
            forecast_info = parse_forecast_content_improved(forecast_content)
            
            await browser.close()
            return format_forecast_answer_improved(forecast_time, forecast_info)
        else:
            await browser.close()
            return "未找到未来三天空间天气预报信息"

def parse_forecast_content_improved(content):
    """
    改进的预报内容解析，避免重复提取
    """
    # 将内容按段落分割
    paragraphs = [p.strip() for p in content.split('\n') if p.strip()]
    
    forecast_info = {
        'solar_activity': [],
        'geomagnetic_activity': [],
        'ionosphere_weather': [],
        'full_content': content
    }
    
    for paragraph in paragraphs:
        # 太阳活动相关
        if any(keyword in paragraph for keyword in ['太阳活动', '耀斑', 'M级', 'X级']):
            if paragraph not in forecast_info['solar_activity']:
                forecast_info['solar_activity'].append(paragraph)
        
        # 地磁活动相关
        elif any(keyword in paragraph for keyword in ['地磁', '冕洞', '质子通量', '高能电子', '太阳风']):
            if paragraph not in forecast_info['geomagnetic_activity']:
                forecast_info['geomagnetic_activity'].append(paragraph)
        
        # 电离层天气相关
        elif '电离层' in paragraph:
            if paragraph not in forecast_info['ionosphere_weather']:
                forecast_info['ionosphere_weather'].append(paragraph)
    
    return forecast_info

def format_forecast_answer_improved(forecast_time, forecast_info):
    """
    改进的预报答案格式化
    """
    now = datetime.now()
    current_time = now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
    
    answer = f"根据国家空间天气监测预警中心发布的预报（发布时间：{forecast_time}，查询时间：{current_time}），未来三天空间天气预报情况如下：\n\n"
    
    # 太阳活动

        for item in forecast_info['solar_activity']:
            answer += f"• {item}\n"
        answer += "\n"
    
    # 地磁活动
    if forecast_info['geomagnetic_activity']:
        answer += f"**地磁活动**：\n"
        for item in forecast_info['geomagnetic_activity']:
            answer += f"• {item}\n"
        answer += "\n"

        answer += "\n"

    total_items = len(forecast_info['solar_activity']) + len(forecast_info['geomagnetic_activity']) + len(forecast_info['ionosphere_weather'])
    if total_items < 3:

import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
from markdownify import markdownify as md
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import re

async def get_highest_scoring_team_last_3_days():
    """
    获取最近3天（不含今天）NBA比赛中得分最高的球队和分数
    """
    # 获取最近3天的日期（不含今天）
    today = datetime.now()
    dates_to_check = []
    
    for i in range(3):  # 1天前、2天前、3天前
        days = i + 1
        date = today - timedelta(days)
        dates_to_check.append(date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"))
    
    print(f"🏀 正在查询最近3天（{', '.join(reversed(dates_to_check))}）NBA比赛中的最高得分...")
    
    all_team_scores = []
    
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        page = await browser.new_page()
        
        for date_str in dates_to_check:
            url = f"https://nba.hupu.com/games/{date_str}"
            print(f"📅 正在查询 {date_str} 的比赛...")
            
            await page.goto(url, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=60000)
            await page.wait_for_timeout(5000)
            
            # 获取页面内容
            full_html = await page.content()
            full_markdown = md(full_html)
            
            # 解析当天所有球队的得分
            daily_scores = parse_all_team_scores(full_markdown, date_str)
            all_team_scores.extend(daily_scores)
            
            print(f"   📊 {date_str}: 找到 {len(daily_scores)} 支球队的得分")
        
        await browser.close()
    
    # 找到最高得分
    if all_team_scores:
        highest_score_info = max(all_team_scores, key=lambda x: x['score'])
        
        answer = f"最近3天（不含今天）NBA比赛中得分最高的球队是 {highest_score_info['team']}，得了 {highest_score_info['score']} 分。\n\n"
        answer += f"比赛详情：\n"
        answer += f"• 日期：{highest_score_info['date']}\n"
        answer += f"• 对阵：{highest_score_info['team']} vs {highest_score_info['opponent']}\n"
        answer += f"• 比分：{highest_score_info['team']} {highest_score_info['score']}-{highest_score_info['opponent_score']} {highest_score_info['opponent']}\n"
        
        # 显示前5名高分球队
        #sorted_scores = sorted(all_team_scores, key=lambda x: x['score'], reverse=True)
        #answer += f"\n最近3天得分前5名：\n"
        #for i, score_info in enumerate(sorted_scores[:5], 1):
        #    answer += f"{i}. {score_info['team']}: {score_info['score']}分 ({score_info['date']})\n"
        
    else:
        answer = "最近3天（不含今天）没有找到NBA比赛数据。"
    
    return answer

def parse_all_team_scores(markdown_text, date_str):
    """
    解析当天所有球队的得分
    """
    lines = markdown_text.split('\n')
    team_scores = []
    
    print(f"      🔍 开始解析 {date_str} 的所有球队得分...")
    
    # 查找所有包含球队和得分的行
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        if 'teams/' in line and '|' in line:
            # 提取球队和得分信息
            parts = [part.strip() for part in line.split('|') if part.strip()]
            
            if len(parts) >= 6:  # 确保有足够的列
                try:
                    # 提取球队名称
                    team_match = re.search(r'\[([^\]]+)\]', parts[0])
                    if team_match:
                        team_name = team_match.group(1)
                        total_score = int(parts[-1])  # 最后一列是总分
                        
                        # 查找对手信息
                        opponent_info = find_opponent_info(lines, i, team_name)
                        
                        if opponent_info:
                            team_scores.append({
                                'date': date_str,
                                'team': team_name,
                                'score': total_score,
                                'opponent': opponent_info['team'],
                                'opponent_score': opponent_info['score']
                            })
                            
                            print(f"         🏀 {team_name}: {total_score}分 vs {opponent_info['team']} {opponent_info['score']}分")
                        
                except (ValueError, IndexError):
                    continue
    
    print(f"      ✅ {date_str} 总计找到 {len(team_scores)} 支球队的得分")
    return team_scores

def find_opponent_info(lines, current_line_idx, current_team):
    """
    查找对手信息
    """
    # 检查相邻行寻找对手
    for offset in [-1, 1]:
        check_line_idx = current_line_idx + offset
        if 0 <= check_line_idx < len(lines):
            check_line = lines[check_line_idx]
            
            if 'teams/' in check_line and '|' in check_line and current_team not in check_line:
                check_parts = [part.strip() for part in check_line.split('|') if part.strip()]
                
                if len(check_parts) >= 6:
                    try:
                        opponent_score = int(check_parts[-1])
                        # 提取球队名称
                        team_match = re.search(r'\[([^\]]+)\]', check_parts[0])
                        if team_match:
                            opponent_name = team_match.group(1)
                            return {
                                'team': opponent_name,
                                'score': opponent_score
                            }
                    except ValueError:
                        continue
    
    return None

# 直接运行异步函数
async def main():
    result = await get_highest_scoring_team_last_3_days()
    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("🎉 最终答案:")
    print("="*60)
    print(result)
    return result

# 执行主函数
result = asyncio.run(main())
print(f"返回结果: {result}")

async def get_current_exhibitions_lasting_more_than_3_months():
    """
    获取深圳博物馆当前正在进行且展期超过3个月的展览信息
    """

        await page.wait_for_timeout(8000)
        
        print("📊 正在获取展览信息...")
        
        # 获取当前时间
        now = datetime.now()
        current_date = now.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
        
        print(f"📅 当前日期: {current_date}")
        
        # 获取页面内容
        body_text = await page.locator("body").inner_text()
        
        # 查找包含日期的展览信息
        print("🔍 查找展览日期信息...")
        
        current_long_exhibitions = []
        
        # 使用正则表达式查找日期格式 YYYY-MM-DD
        date_pattern = r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})-(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})'
        date_matches = re.findall(date_pattern, body_text)
        
        print(f"找到 {len(date_matches)} 个日期范围")
        
        # 分析每个日期范围
        for start_date_str, end_date_str in date_matches:
            try:
                start_date = datetime.strptime(start_date_str, "%Y-%m-%d")
                end_date = datetime.strptime(end_date_str, "%Y-%m-%d")
                
                # 计算展期长度
                duration = end_date - start_date
                duration_days = duration.days
                duration_months = duration_days / 30.44  # 平均每月天数
                
                print(f"\n📅 分析展期: {start_date_str} 至 {end_date_str}")
                print(f"  📏 展期长度: {duration_days} 天 ({duration_months:.1f} 个月)")
                
                # 检查是否当前正在进行且展期超过3个月
                is_currently_ongoing = (start_date <= now <= end_date)
                is_long_duration = (duration_days >= 90)
                
                print(f"  🏷️ 当前是否正在进行: {'是' if is_currently_ongoing else '否'}")
                print(f"  📏 展期是否超过3个月: {'是' if is_long_duration else '否'}")
                
                if is_currently_ongoing and is_long_duration:
                    
                    print(f"  ✅ 符合条件：当前正在进行且展期超过3个月")
                    
                    # 查找这个日期附近的展览名称
                    lines = body_text.split('\n')
                    exhibition_found = False
                    
                    # 查找包含日期信息的行
                    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
                        if start_date_str in line:
                            # 向上查找展览名称（通常在日期之前）
                            for j in range(1, 15):
                                if i - j >= 0:
                                    potential_name = lines[i - j].strip()
                                    if (potential_name and 
                                        len(potential_name) > 5 and
                                        not re.match(r'^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}', potential_name) and
                                        potential_name not in ['正在展出', '即将展出', '已结束', '临时展览', '常设展览', '展览回顾', '云上展览']):
                                        
                                        # 计算已经进行的天数和剩余天数
                                        days_elapsed = (now - start_date).days
                                        days_remaining = (end_date - now).days
                                        
                                        exhibition_info = {
                                            'name': potential_name,
                                            'start_date': start_date_str,
                                            'end_date': end_date_str,
                                            'duration_days': duration_days,
                                            'duration_months': round(duration_months, 1),
                                            'days_elapsed': days_elapsed,
                                            'days_remaining': days_remaining
                                        }
                                        
                                        current_long_exhibitions.append(exhibition_info)
                                        print(f"  📋 展览名称: {potential_name}")
                                        print(f"  ⏱️ 总展期: {duration_months:.1f} 个月")
                                        print(f"  📈 已进行: {days_elapsed} 天")
                                        print(f"  📉 剩余: {days_remaining} 天")
                                        exhibition_found = True
                                        break
                            
                            if exhibition_found:
                                break
                    
                    if not exhibition_found:
                        print(f"  ❌ 未找到对应的展览名称")
                else:
                    if not is_currently_ongoing:
                        if end_date < now:
                            print(f"  ❌ 展览已结束")
                        else:
                            print(f"  ❌ 展览尚未开始")
                    if not is_long_duration:
                        print(f"  ❌ 展期不足3个月")
                    
            except ValueError:
                print(f"  ❌ 日期格式错误: {start_date_str} - {end_date_str}")
                continue
        
        await browser.close()
        
        # 去重处理
        unique_exhibitions = []
        seen_names = set()
        
        for exhibition in current_long_exhibitions:
            name_key = exhibition['name'].lower().replace(' ', '')
            if name_key not in seen_names:
                unique_exhibitions.append(exhibition)
                seen_names.add(name_key)
        
        # 按展期长度排序（从长到短）
        unique_exhibitions.sort(key=lambda x: x['duration_days'], reverse=True)
        
        # 生成答案
        if unique_exhibitions:
            answer = f"截至{current_date}，深圳博物馆当前正在进行且展期超过3个月的展览有 {len(unique_exhibitions)} 个：\n\n"
            
            for i, exhibition in enumerate(unique_exhibitions, 1):
                answer += f"{i}. **{exhibition['name']}**\n"
                answer += f"   展期: {exhibition['start_date']} 至 {exhibition['end_date']}\n"
                answer += f"   总展期长度: {exhibition['duration_months']} 个月 ({exhibition['duration_days']} 天)\n"
                answer += f"   已进行: {exhibition['days_elapsed']} 天，剩余: {exhibition['days_remaining']} 天\n\n"
        else:
            answer = f"截至{current_date}，深圳博物馆当前没有正在进行且展期超过3个月的展览。"
        
        return answer

async def main():

    print(result)
    return result

async def solve_seven_temperature():
    """解决函数：使用不同的函数处理不同页面，然后合并数据并计算。"""
    print("--- 正在执行解决函数 solve_seven_temperature ---")
    
    url = "https://www.weather.com.cn/weather40d/101130101.shtml"
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        page = await browser.new_page()
        await page.goto(url, timeout=60000)
        
        # 1. 获取第一页数据
        page1_data = await get_initial_page_data(page)
        if not page1_data:
            print("错误：未能从初始页面获取数据。")
            await browser.close()
            return
        
        await asyncio.sleep(5)
        # 2. 翻页并获取第二页的原始数据
        print("\n>>> 正在向前翻页...")
        left_arrow_locator = page.locator("div.L_yue span.Y_left")
        first_day_locator = page.locator("div.w_riqi").first
        first_day_before_click = await first_day_locator.text_content()
        await left_arrow_locator.first.click()
        await expect(first_day_locator).not_to_have_text(first_day_before_click, timeout=5000)
        print("--- 页面已更新 ---")
        page2_raw_data = await get_historical_page_data(page)
        await asyncio.sleep(5)
        await browser.close()

    # 3. 为第二页数据补全日期并合并
    page2_data = []
    if page2_raw_data:
        # 获取第一页数据中的最早日期作为推算的基准
        earliest_date_page1 = min(d['date'] for d in page1_data)
        
        # 因为页面是倒序的，所以我们反转第二页数据来正向推算
        page2_raw_data.reverse()
        
        current_date = earliest_date_page1 - timedelta(days=1)
        for raw_data in page2_raw_data:
            # 检查月份是否正确
            if raw_data['day'] == current_date.day:
                page2_data.append({
                    "date": current_date,
                    "max_temp": raw_data['max_temp'],
                    "min_temp": raw_data['min_temp']
                })
                current_date -= timedelta(days=1)
            else:
                continue
    page2_data.reverse()
    all_weather_data = list(page2_data) + list(page1_data)

    # 4. 最终计算
    data_map = {d['date'].date(): d for d in all_weather_data}
    today_date = datetime.now().date()
    last_week_dates = [(today_date - timedelta(days=i)) for i in range(1, 8)]
    last_week_temps = []
    for date_to_find in last_week_dates:
        if date_to_find in data_map:
            last_week_temps.append(data_map[date_to_find]['max_temp'])

    print("7天最高温度：", last_week_temps)
    
    if len(last_week_temps) == 7:
        average_temp = sum(last_week_temps) / len(last_week_temps)
        print("\n========================================")
        print(f" 过去7天（不含今天）：({last_week_dates[-1].strftime('%Y-%m-%d')} 到 {last_week_dates[0].strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}) 的平均最高温度是: {average_temp:.2f}℃")
        print("========================================")
        return average_temp
    else:
        print(f"\n错误：数据不完整，无法计算。已获取 {len(last_week_temps)}/7 天。")
        return None

# --- 脚本主入口 ---
if __name__ == "__main__":
    result = asyncio.run(solve_seven_temperature())
    print(result)

import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
from markdownify import markdownify as md
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import re
from typing import List, Dict, Optional

async def fetch_global_level7_earthquake_html() -> Optional[str]:
    """
    获取全球七级以上地震信息的HTML内容
    """
    url = "https://data.earthquake.cn/datashare/report.shtml?PAGEID=qqqjall"
    
    print(f"🚀 正在访问全球七级以上地震信息网站: {url}")
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        page = await browser.new_page()
        await page.goto(url, wait_until="load")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(5000)  # 等待数据加载
        
        # 查找包含地震数据的表格
        earthquake_table = page.locator("table").filter(has_text="震级")
        if await earthquake_table.count() > 0:
            print("✅ 找到地震数据表格")
            html_content = await earthquake_table.first.inner_html()
            await browser.close()
            return html_content
        
        await browser.close()
        return None

def parse_earthquake_data(html_content):
    markdown_text = md(html_content)
    lines = [line.strip() for line in markdown_text.split('\n') if line.strip()]
    earthquakes = []
    
    # 查找包含所有数据的那一行
    for line in lines:
        if '|' in line and '序号' in line and '发震时刻' in line:
            # 分割表格列
            parts = [part.strip() for part in line.split('|') if part.strip()]
            
            # 找到表头位置
            try:
                header_start = parts.index('序号')
                header = parts[header_start:header_start + 7]  # 7列表头
                
                # 从表头后开始解析数据
                data_start = header_start + 7
                
                # 每7列为一条记录
                i = data_start
                while i + 6 < len(parts):
                    try:
                        sequence = parts[i]
                        time_str = parts[i + 1]
                        longitude = float(parts[i + 2])
                        latitude = float(parts[i + 3])
                        depth = int(parts[i + 4])
                        magnitude = float(parts[i + 5])
                        location = parts[i + 6]
                        
                        # 验证是否为有效的地震数据行
                        if re.search(r'\d{4}-\d{1,2}-\d{1,2}\s+\d{1,2}:\d{2}:\d{2}', time_str):
                            # 清理地点信息中的链接格式
                            location = re.sub(r'\[([^\]]+)\].*', r'\1', location)
                            
                            earthquake = {
                                'sequence': sequence,
                                'time': time_str,
                                'longitude': longitude,
                                'latitude': latitude,
                                'depth': depth,
                                'magnitude': magnitude,
                                'location': location
                            }
                            earthquakes.append(earthquake)
                            print(f"   - 解析地震: {earthquake['time']} {earthquake['location']} M{earthquake['magnitude']}")
                    
                    except (ValueError, IndexError) as e:
                        pass  # 跳过无效数据
                    
                    i += 7  # 移动到下一条记录
                    
                break  # 找到数据后退出循环
                
            except ValueError:
                continue
    
    print(f"总共解析到 {len(earthquakes)} 条地震记录")
    return earthquakes

def check_level7_earthquakes_last_three_months(earthquakes: List[Dict]) -> Dict:
    """
    检查最近三个月全球七级以上地震记录
    """
    print("🔍 正在检查从现在开始，过去90天（90×24小时）全球七级以上地震记录...")
    
    # 获取最近三个月的日期范围
    today = datetime.now()
    three_months_ago = today - timedelta(days=90)
    
    level7_earthquakes = []
    
    for eq in earthquakes:
        # 解析地震时间
        eq_time = datetime.strptime(eq['time'], "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
        
        # 检查是否在从现在开始，过去90天（90×24小时）内且震级大于等于7级
        if eq_time >= three_months_ago and eq['magnitude'] >= 7.0:
            level7_earthquakes.append(eq)
    
    result = {
        'start_date': three_months_ago.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
        'end_date': today.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
        'count': len(level7_earthquakes),
        'earthquakes': level7_earthquakes
    }
    
    print(f"   - 从现在开始，过去90天（90×24小时）({result['start_date']} 至 {result['end_date']})全球共发生 {len(level7_earthquakes)} 次七级以上地震")
    
    return result

async def get_global_level7_three_months_earthquake_answer():
    """
    获取最从现在开始，过去90天（90×24小时）全球七级以上地震情况的答案
    """
    # 步骤1: 获取HTML数据
    html_content = await fetch_global_level7_earthquake_html()
    
    # 步骤2: 解析地震数据
    earthquakes = parse_earthquake_data(html_content)
    
    # 步骤3: 检查最近三个月七级以上地震情况
    level7_result = check_level7_earthquakes_last_three_months(earthquakes)
    
    # 步骤4: 生成答案
    print("\n" + "="*50)
    print("🎉 最终答案:")
    print("="*50 + "\n")
    
    if level7_result['count'] > 0:
        answer = f"根据国家地震科学数据中心的数据，从现在开始，过去90天（90×24小时）({level7_result['start_date']} 至 {level7_result['end_date']})全球共记录到 **{level7_result['count']} 次七级以上地震**：\n\n"
        
        for i, eq in enumerate(level7_result['earthquakes'], 1):
            answer += f"{i}. **{eq['time']}** - {eq['location']} - 震级M{eq['magnitude']} - 深度{eq['depth']}千米\n"
    else:
        answer = f"根据国家地震科学数据中心的数据，从现在开始，过去90天（90×24小时）({level7_result['start_date']} 至 {level7_result['end_date']})全球 **没有记录到七级以上地震**。"
    
    print(answer)
    return answer

# 直接运行异步函数测试

async def get_beijing_to_xian_high_speed_trains_tomorrow():

    """
    # 获取明天的日期

    print(f"🚄 正在查询明天({date_str})从北京到西安的高铁动车信息...")
    print(f"访问URL: {url}")
    
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        page = await browser.new_page()
        await page.goto(url, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=600000)

        # 去重

        for train in all_trains:
            if train not in unique_trains and len(train) <= 6:

    """

            continue
            
        seen_cars.add(car_name)

        time_match = re.search(r'(\d+\.?\d*)', consumption_str)

    # 提取批次信息
    batch_match = re.search(r'第(\d+)批.*总第(\d+)批', title)

        r'发现(\d+)款',
        r'发现(\d+)个',
        r'(\d+)款.*存在.*侵害',
        r'(\d+)个.*存在.*侵害'
    ]
    
    violation_count = "未知"
    for pattern in count_patterns:
        match = re.search(pattern, content)

            break
    
    # 构建结果
    result = f"""工信部最新一次侵害用户权益行为通报详情：

- 发现违规数量：{violation_count}款/个
- 通报对象：{report_type}

此为截至当前时间的最新通报，发布时间为{report_date}。"""
    
    return result

                rank_part = parts[0]
                name_part = parts[1] 
                percentage_part = parts[2]
                
                # 清理城市名

                city_name = re.sub(r'(\S+省)\1', r'\1', city_name)

                if '%' in percentage_part and rank_part.isdigit():

                    }

        if bright_asteroids:

        else:

        return answer

def parse_asteroid_data_for_brightness(markdown_text):
    """
    解析小行星数据表格，重点关注亮度信息
    """
    print("🔍 正在解析小行星数据...")
    asteroids = []
    lines = markdown_text.split('\n')
    
    for line in lines:
        if '|' in line and any(char.isdigit() for char in line):
            parts = [part.strip() for part in line.split('|') if part.strip()]
            
            if len(parts) >= 4:  # 确保有足够的列
                # 提取小行星名称（去掉链接格式）
                name_part = parts[0]
                # 提取括号内的名称或数字
                if '[' in name_part and ']' in name_part:
                    name_match = name_part.split('[')[1].split(']')[0]
                    name = name_match.split('(')[0].strip()  # 去掉链接部分
                else:
                    name = name_part
                
                # 跳过表头
                if name.lower() in ['asteroid', 'brightness', 'altitude', 'constellation']:
                    continue
                
                try:
                    brightness = float(parts[1])
                    altitude = parts[2]
                    constellation = parts[3]
                    
                    asteroid_info = {
                        'name': name,
                        'brightness': brightness,
                        'altitude': altitude,
                        'constellation': constellation
                    }
                    asteroids.append(asteroid_info)
                    print(f"   解析到小行星: {name} (亮度: {brightness})")
                except (ValueError, IndexError):
                    continue
    
    return asteroids

# 直接运行异步函数

    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("🎉 最终答案:")
    print("="*60)
    print(result)
    return result

L3_问题: 某国总统于与当地时间2024年8月1日在该国首都宣誓就职，成为该国历史上第二位女性总统，2025年10月15日与该国续签本币互换协议的银行，自今年1月1日以来是否发布过预算或决算相关公告？
工作流:
import requests
from lxml import html
from datetime import datetime
from markdownify import markdownify as md


def check_budget_announcements_this_year():
    """
    检查中国人民银行自今年1月1日以来是否发布过预算或决算相关公告。
    通过抓取官网公告列表页面实现。
    """
    # 公告列表的直接数据源URL
    data_source_url = "http://www.pbc.gov.cn/rmyh/105208/index.html"
    base_url = "http://www.pbc.gov.cn"

    headers = {
        'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/91.0.4472.124 Safari/537.36'
    }

    print("问题: '自从今年1月1日以来，中国人民银行是否发布过预算或决算相关公告？'")
    print(f"官方数据来自于: {data_source_url}\n")

    # 1. 获取页面内容
    response = requests.get(data_source_url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
    response.raise_for_status()
    tree = html.fromstring(response.content)

    # 2. 查找包含公告条目的所有表格行<tr>
    article_rows = tree.xpath("//tr[td/font[@class='newslist_style']]")

    if not article_rows:
        print("Error: 无法在页面上找到任何公告行。页面结构可能已更改。")
        return

    # 3. 定义过滤条件
    current_year = datetime.now().year
    start_date = datetime(current_year, 1, 1).date()
    budget_keywords = ["预算", "决算"]
    
    found_announcements = []

    # 4. 遍历每一行，提取所需数据
    for row in article_rows:
        # 从当前行(.)使用相对XPath
        link_element = row.xpath(".//font[@class='newslist_style']/a")
        date_element = row.xpath(".//span[@class='hui12']/text()")

        # 确保两个元素都找到了再继续
        if link_element and date_element:
            link_element = link_element[0]
            title = link_element.text_content().strip()
            date_str = date_element[0].strip()
            
            # 将日期字符串解析为日期对象
            article_date = datetime.strptime(date_str, '%Y-%m-%d').date()

            # 应用过滤条件
            is_budget_announcement = any(keyword in title for keyword in budget_keywords)
            is_in_this_year = article_date >= start_date

            if is_budget_announcement and is_in_this_year:
                relative_url = link_element.get('href')
                full_url = base_url + "/" + relative_url.replace('../', '')
                found_announcements.append({
                    'date': article_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),
                    'title': title,
                    'url': full_url
                })
    
    # 5. 输出最终答案
    print("--- 分析完成 ---")
    if found_announcements:
        print(f"\n标准答案是: 是 - 自{start_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}以来，中国人民银行共发布了{len(found_announcements)}次预算或决算相关公告。")
        print("具体如下:\n")
        for i, ann in enumerate(found_announcements, 1):
            print(f"{i}. 日期: {ann['date']}")
            print(f"   标题: {ann['title']}")
            print(f"   链接: {ann['url']}\n")
        return '是'
    else:
        print(f"\n标准答案是: 否 - 根据公告，自{start_date.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}以来，中国人民银行未发布过预算或决算相关公告。")
        return '否'

# --- Run the analysis ---
if __name__ == "__main__":
    result = check_budget_announcements_this_year()
    print(f"最终答案: {result}")

L1_问题: 最近60天内（含今天），工信部发布了几次侵害用户权益行为的APP（包括SDK）通报，总共发现了多少款违规APP？
L2_问题: 已知某一部门的副部长辛国斌于2025年10月21日在北京主持召开工业经济形势展望专家座谈会，距离今天最近的60天内（含今天）该部门发布了几次侵害用户权益行为的APP（包括SDK）通报，总共发现了多少款违规APP？
工作流:
import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
from markdownify import markdownify as md
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import re

async def get_app_reports_last_60_days():
    """
    获取最近60天内工信部发布的侵害用户权益行为APP（包括SDK）通报统计
    """
    base_url = "https://www.miit.gov.cn"
    main_url = "https://www.miit.gov.cn/jgsj/xgj/gzdt/index.html"
    
    # 计算60天前的日期
    now = datetime.now()
    sixty_days_ago = now - timedelta(days=60)
    
    print(f"🕒 当前时间: {now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')}")
    print(f"📅 查找范围: {sixty_days_ago.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')} 至 {now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')} (最近60天)")
    
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        page = await browser.new_page()
        await page.goto(main_url, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=60000)
        await page.wait_for_timeout(5000)
        
        print("📋 正在查找APP相关通报...")
        
        # 查找所有新闻项
        news_items = page.locator("li")
        item_count = await news_items.count()
        
        # 查找所有APP相关的通报
        app_reports = []
        
        for i in range(item_count):
            try:
                item = news_items.nth(i)
                item_text = await item.inner_text()
                
                # 检查是否为APP通报（包括SDK）
                if ("侵害" in item_text and "用户" in item_text and "权益" in item_text and 
                    "通报" in item_text and "APP" in item_text):
                    
                    print(f"找到APP通报: {item_text[:80]}")
                    
                    # 提取日期
                    date_match = re.search(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', item_text)
                    if date_match:
                        report_date_str = date_match.group(1)
                        report_date = datetime.strptime(report_date_str, '%Y-%m-%d')
                        
                        # 检查是否在最近60天内
                        if report_date >= sixty_days_ago:
                            print(f"  ✅ 在60天范围内: {report_date_str}")
                            
                            # 查找链接
                            link_element = item.locator("a").first
                            report_link = await link_element.get_attribute("href")
                            
                            if report_link and not report_link.startswith("http"):
                                report_link = base_url + report_link
                            
                            app_reports.append({
                                'text': item_text.strip(),
                                'date': report_date_str,
                                'date_obj': report_date,
                                'link': report_link
                            })
                        else:
                            print(f"  ❌ 超出60天范围: {report_date_str}")
            except:
                continue
        
        print(f"\n📊 最近60天内找到 {len(app_reports)} 个APP通报")
        
        if not app_reports:
            await browser.close()
            return "最近60天内未找到APP相关通报"
        
        # 按日期排序
        app_reports.sort(key=lambda x: x['date_obj'], reverse=True)
        
        # 访问每个通报页面获取详细信息
        detailed_reports = []
        total_violations = 0
        
        for report in app_reports:
            print(f"\n🔍 正在分析通报: {report['date']} - {report['text'][:50]}...")
            
            try:
                await page.goto(report['link'], wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=60000)
                await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
                
                # 获取页面内容
                title = await page.title()
                content = await page.locator("body").inner_text()
                
                # 解析违规数量
                violation_info = parse_app_violation_count(content, title)
                
                detailed_reports.append({
                    'date': report['date'],
                    'title': title,
                    'violation_count': violation_info['total'],
                    'type': violation_info['type']
                })
                
                total_violations += violation_info['total']
                
                print(f"  📱 发现违规: {violation_info['total']}款 ({violation_info['type']})")
                
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"  ❌ 解析失败: {str(e)}")
                continue
        
        await browser.close()
        
        # 生成统计报告
        report_summary = generate_60day_summary(detailed_reports, total_violations,
                                              sixty_days_ago.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'), 
                                              now.strftime('%Y-%m-%d'))
        
        return report_summary

def parse_app_violation_count(content, title):
    """
    解析APP通报中的违规数量
    """
    result = {
        'total': 0,
        'type': 'APP'
    }
    
    # 判断通报类型
    if "SDK" in title:
        result['type'] = 'APP和SDK'
    else:
        result['type'] = 'APP'
    
    # 提取总数量
    count_patterns = [
        r'共发现(\d+)款.*存在侵害用户权益行为',
        r'发现(\d+)款.*侵害',
        r'(\d+)款.*存在.*侵害'
    ]
    
    for pattern in count_patterns:
        match = re.search(pattern, content)
        if match:
            result['total'] = int(match.group(1))
            print(f"    使用模式 '{pattern}' 找到数量: {result['total']}")
            break
    
    return result

def generate_60day_summary(reports, total_violations, start_date, end_date):
    """
    生成60天统计摘要
    """
    report_count = len(reports)
    
    result = f"""最近60天内工信部APP侵害用户权益通报统计：

统计时间范围
- 起始日期：{start_date}
- 截止日期：{end_date}
- 统计天数：60天

通报次数统计
- 发布通报次数：{report_count}次
- 通报类型：APP侵害用户权益行为通报（包括SDK）

违规应用统计
- 总计发现违规APP：{total_violations}款

"""
    
    return result

# 直接运行异步函数
async def main():
    result = await get_app_reports_last_60_days()
    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("🎉 最终答案:")
    print("="*60)
    print(result)
    return result

# 执行主函数
result = asyncio.run(main())
print(f"返回结果: {result}")

L1_问题: 根据百度迁徙平台最新数据，哪些省份的迁入比例超过了5%？
工作流:
import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
from markdownify import markdownify as md
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import re

async def get_provinces_with_high_inbound_ratio():
    """
    获取哪些省份的迁入比例超过了5%
    """
    url = "https://qianxi.baidu.com/#/"
    
    print(f"🌐 正在访问百度迁徙平台...")
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        page = await browser.new_page()
        await page.goto(url, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=60000)
        await page.wait_for_timeout(5000)
        
        print("📊 切换到省份级别...")
        # 切换到省份级别
        province_buttons = await page.locator("text=省份级别").all()
        if len(province_buttons) > 0:
            await province_buttons[0].click()
            await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
        
        # 获取热门迁入地数据
        print("📥 获取热门迁入省份数据...")
        inbound_data = await page.locator("body").inner_text()
        
        await browser.close()
        
        # 解析数据
        inbound_provinces = parse_province_data(inbound_data, "迁入")
        
        # 筛选迁入比例超过5%的省份
        high_inbound_provinces = filter_high_inbound_provinces(inbound_provinces, 5.0)
        
        now = datetime.now()
        twenty_four_hours_ago = now - timedelta(hours=24)
        
        # 生成答案
        answer = f"根据百度迁徙平台数据最新数据,迁入比例超过5%的省份如下：\n\n"
        
        if high_inbound_provinces:
            answer += f"**共有 {len(high_inbound_provinces)} 个省份的迁入比例超过5%：**\n\n"
            for i, (province, percentage) in enumerate(high_inbound_provinces, 1):
                answer += f"{i}. **{province}** - {percentage}%\n"
            
            answer += f"\n📊 **数据分析：**\n"
            answer += f"- 最高迁入比例：{high_inbound_provinces[0][1]}%（{high_inbound_provinces[0][0]}）\n"
            answer += f"- 这些省份占全国迁入总量的 {sum([pct for _, pct in high_inbound_provinces]):.2f}%\n"
            answer += f"- 说明这些省份在全国人口迁移中具有强大的吸引力"
        else:
            answer += "**没有省份的迁入比例超过5%**\n\n"
            answer += "📊 所有省份的迁入比例都在5%以下，说明全国人口迁移相对分散，没有特别突出的迁入热点省份。"
        
        return answer

def parse_province_data(text_data, data_type):
    """
    解析省份迁徙数据，返回省份和百分比的元组列表
    """
    print(f"🔍 正在解析{data_type}数据...")
    provinces = []
    lines = text_data.split('\n')
    
    i = 0
    while i < len(lines):
        line = lines[i].strip()
        
        # 查找数字开头的行（排名）
        if re.match(r'^\d+$', line):
            rank = int(line)
            
            # 下一行应该是省份名称
            if i + 1 < len(lines):
                province_line = lines[i + 1].strip()
                
                # 再下一行应该是百分比
                if i + 2 < len(lines):
                    percentage_line = lines[i + 2].strip()
                    
                    # 检查是否是百分比格式
                    if re.match(r'^\d+\.\d+%$', percentage_line):
                        province = province_line.replace('\t', '').strip()
                        if province and not re.match(r'^\d', province):
                            # 转换百分比为数值
                            percentage_value = float(percentage_line.replace('%', ''))
                            provinces.append((province, percentage_value))
                            print(f"   解析到: {rank}. {province} - {percentage_line}")
                        
                        i += 3
                        continue
        
        i += 1
        
        # 限制只解析前20个结果
        if len(provinces) >= 20:
            break
    
    return provinces

def filter_high_inbound_provinces(provinces_data, threshold):
    """
    筛选迁入比例超过指定阈值的省份
    """
    print(f"🔍 筛选迁入比例超过{threshold}%的省份...")
    high_inbound = []
    
    for province, percentage in provinces_data:
        if percentage > threshold:
            high_inbound.append((province, percentage))
            print(f"   符合条件: {province} - {percentage}%")
    
    print(f"共找到 {len(high_inbound)} 个符合条件的省份")
    return high_inbound

# 直接运行异步函数
async def main():
    result = await get_provinces_with_high_inbound_ratio()
    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("🎉 最终答案:")
    print("="*60)
    print(result)
    return result

# 执行主函数
result = asyncio.run(main())
print(f"返回结果: {result}")

import asyncio
from playwright.async_api import async_playwright
from markdownify import markdownify as md
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
import re

async def get_arxiv_cs_papers_last_7_days():
    """
    获取arXiv上计算机科学领域过去7天（不包含今天）共提交的论文数量
    """
    url = "https://arxiv.org/search/advanced"
    
    # 计算过去7天的日期范围（不包含今天）
    now = datetime.now()
    end_date = now - timedelta(days=1)  # 昨天
    start_date = end_date - timedelta(days=6)  # 7天前
    
    start_date_str = start_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    end_date_str = end_date.strftime("%Y-%m-%d")
    
    print(f"🗓️ 搜索日期范围: {start_date_str} 到 {end_date_str} (过去7天，不包含今天)")
    
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        page = await browser.new_page()
        await page.goto(url, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=60000)
        await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
        
        print("🔍 正在设置搜索条件...")
        
        # 选择计算机科学分类（checkbox）
        cs_checkbox = page.locator("input[name='classification-computer_science']")
        await cs_checkbox.check()
        print("✅ 已选择计算机科学领域")
        
        # 设置日期筛选
        # 选择按日期范围筛选
        date_range_radio = page.locator("input[id='date-filter_by-3']")
        await date_range_radio.check()
        print("✅ 已选择按日期范围筛选")
        
        # 设置开始日期
        from_date_input = page.locator("input[name='date-from_date']")
        await from_date_input.fill(start_date_str)
        print(f"✅ 已设置开始日期: {start_date_str}")
        
        # 设置结束日期
        to_date_input = page.locator("input[name='date-to_date']")
        await to_date_input.fill(end_date_str)
        print(f"✅ 已设置结束日期: {end_date_str}")
        
        # 设置结果数量为最大
        size_select = page.locator("select[name='size']")
        await size_select.select_option("200")
        print("✅ 已设置每页显示200个结果")
        
        # 执行搜索 - 使用正确的按钮选择器
        search_button = page.locator("button.is-link.is-medium").last
        await search_button.click()
        print("🔍 正在执行搜索...")
        
        # 等待搜索结果加载
        await page.wait_for_timeout(5000)
        
        # 获取当前页面URL以确认搜索已执行
        current_url = page.url
        print(f"当前页面URL: {current_url}")
        
        # 获取搜索结果数量
        total_results = 0
        
        # 方法1: 查找结果统计信息
        result_stats = page.locator("h1, .search-info, .results-info")
        if await result_stats.count() > 0:
            for i in range(await result_stats.count()):
                text = await result_stats.nth(i).inner_text()
                print(f"结果信息 {i+1}: {text}")
                
                # 从文本中提取总结果数
                # 常见格式: "Showing 1–25 of 1,234 results"
                match = re.search(r'of\s+([\d,]+)\s+results?', text, re.IGNORECASE)
                if match:
                    total_results = int(match.group(1).replace(',', ''))
                    print(f"找到总结果数: {total_results}")
                    break
                
                # 另一种格式: "1,234 results"
                match = re.search(r'([\d,]+)\s+results?', text, re.IGNORECASE)
                if match:
                    total_results = int(match.group(1).replace(',', ''))
                    print(f"找到总结果数: {total_results}")
                    break
        
        # 方法2: 如果没有找到统计信息，计算当前页面的论文数量
        if total_results == 0:
            articles = page.locator("li.arxiv-result, .arxiv-result")
            article_count = await articles.count()
            print(f"当前页面找到 {article_count} 篇论文")
            
            # 检查是否有"No results found"之类的信息
            no_results = page.locator("text=No results, text=0 results")
            if await no_results.count() > 0:
                total_results = 0
            else:
                # 如果有论文但没有找到总数，可能需要翻页统计
                total_results = article_count
                
                # 检查是否有分页信息
                pagination = page.locator(".pagination, .pager, nav")
                if await pagination.count() > 0:
                    pagination_text = await pagination.inner_text()
                    print(f"分页信息: {pagination_text}")
        
        # 获取页面内容用于调试
        page_content = await page.content()
        if "No results" in page_content or "0 results" in page_content:
            total_results = 0
        
        await browser.close()
        
        answer = f"arXiv上计算机科学领域过去7天（不包含今天，即{start_date_str}到{end_date_str}）共提交了 {total_results} 篇论文。"
        return answer

# 执行主函数
async def main():
    result = await get_arxiv_cs_papers_last_7_days()
    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("🎉 最终答案:")
    print("="*60)
    print(result)
    return result

result = asyncio.run(main())

async def get_chongqing_foreign_performances_next_week():
    """
    获取下周（下周一至下周三）重庆地区涉外营业性演出活动数量
    """

    now = datetime.now()
    
    # 获取下周一的日期
    days_since_monday = now.weekday()  # 0=周一, 6=周日
    next_monday = now + timedelta(days=7 - days_since_monday)
    next_wednesday = next_monday + timedelta(days=2)
    
    start_date = next_monday.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
    end_date = next_wednesday.strftime('%Y-%m-%d')
    
    base_url = "https://zwfw.mct.gov.cn/wycx/qgswyyxychd/qgswyyxychdjg/"
    params = {
        'qgswperformanceName': '',
        'qgswperformancePlace1': '重庆',
        'qgswperformingBeginTime': start_date,
        'qgswperformingEndTime': end_date
    }
    
    # 构建完整的URL
    query_string = urllib.parse.urlencode(params, quote_via=urllib.parse.quote)
    search_url = f"{base_url}?{query_string}"
    
    print(f"🎭 正在查询重庆地区下周（{start_date}至{end_date}）的涉外营业性演出活动...")
    print(f"访问URL: {search_url}")
    
    async with async_playwright() as p:
        browser = await p.chromium.launch(headless=True)
        page = await browser.new_page()
        
        # 设置用户代理
        await page.set_extra_http_headers({
            'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/91.0.4472.124 Safari/537.36'
        })
        
        await page.goto(search_url, wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=60000)
        await page.wait_for_timeout(5000)
        
        print("📊 正在解析演出数据...")
        
        # 收集所有演出信息
        all_performances = []
        current_page = 1
        
        # 获取所有页面的演出信息
        while True:
            print(f"正在处理第 {current_page} 页...")
            
            # 获取当前页面的分页信息
            page_text = await page.locator('body').inner_text()
            
            # 解析总数和分页信息
            total_count = 0
            current_page_num = 1
            total_pages = 1
            
            count_match = re.search(r'共(\d+)条', page_text)
            if count_match:
                total_count = int(count_match.group(1))
                print(f"官方显示总演出数量: {total_count}")
            
            # 解析当前页和总页数
            page_match = re.search(r'当前第\s*(\d+)页\s*共(\d+)页', page_text)
            if page_match:
                current_page_num = int(page_match.group(1))
                total_pages = int(page_match.group(2))
                print(f"分页信息: 当前第 {current_page_num} 页，共 {total_pages} 页")
            
            # 解析当前页面的演出信息
            performances = await parse_performances_from_current_page(page)
            
            print(f"当前页面找到 {len(performances)} 场演出")
            
            # 添加到总列表
            all_performances.extend(performances)
            
            # 判断是否需要继续翻页
            if current_page_num >= total_pages:
                print(f"已处理完所有 {total_pages} 页，停止翻页")
                break
            
            # 检查是否有下一页并且下一页链接有效
            next_page_links = await page.locator('a:has-text("下一页")').all()
            
            has_valid_next_page = False
            if len(next_page_links) > 0:
                next_page_element = next_page_links[0]
                href = await next_page_element.get_attribute('href')
                
                # 检查下一页链接是否指向更高的页码
                if href and 'goPage' in href:
                    # 从href中提取页码
                    page_num_match = re.search(r'goPage\((\d+)\)', href)
                    if page_num_match:
                        target_page = int(page_num_match.group(1))
                        if target_page > current_page_num:
                            print(f"发现有效的下一页链接，跳转到第 {target_page} 页...")
                            await next_page_element.click()
                            await page.wait_for_timeout(3000)
                            current_page += 1
                            has_valid_next_page = True
                        else:
                            print(f"下一页链接指向第 {target_page} 页，不是有效的下一页")
                    else:
                        print("无法从下一页链接中提取页码")
                else:
                    print("下一页链接无效或不包含goPage函数")
            else:
                print("没有找到下一页链接")
            
            if not has_valid_next_page:
                break
            
            # 防止无限循环
            if current_page > 50:
                print("已处理超过50页，停止翻页")
                break
        
        await browser.close()
        
        print(f"最终解析到 {len(all_performances)} 场演出")
        
        # 去重处理（基于演出名称和日期）
        unique_performances = []
        seen_performances = set()
        
        for perf in all_performances:
            key = f"{perf['name']}_{perf['date']}"
            if key not in seen_performances:
                seen_performances.add(key)
                unique_performances.append(perf)
        
        print(f"去重后共 {len(unique_performances)} 场不重复的演出")
        
        # 按日期排序演出
        unique_performances.sort(key=lambda x: x['date'])
        
        # 生成答案
        if unique_performances:
            answer = f"根据中华人民共和国文化和旅游部的官方信息，下周一至下周三（{start_date}至{end_date}）重庆地区共有 {len(unique_performances)} 场涉外营业性演出活动。\n\n"
            
            answer += f"具体演出详情如下：\n\n"
            for i, perf in enumerate(unique_performances, 1):
                answer += f"{i}. **{perf['name']}** - {perf['date']}\n"
            
            answer += f"\n📊 数据来源：中华人民共和国文化和旅游部官方网站"
        else:
            answer = f"根据中华人民共和国文化和旅游部的官方信息，下周一至下周三（{start_date}至{end_date}）重庆地区暂无涉外营业性演出活动，为0场。"
        
        return answer

async def parse_performances_from_current_page(page):
    """
    从当前页面解析演出信息
    """
    performances = []
    
    # 检查是否有表格
    table_count = await page.locator('table').count()
    
    if table_count > 0:
        # 从表格中提取数据
        table = page.locator('table').first
        rows = await table.locator('tr').all()
        
        for row in rows:
            cells = await row.locator('td').all()
            if len(cells) >= 2:
                name_cell = cells[0]
                date_cell = cells[1]
                
                name = await name_cell.inner_text()
                date = await date_cell.inner_text()
                
                name = name.strip()
                date = date.strip()
                
                # 验证数据有效性
                if (name and date and 
                    name != '演出名称' and date != '演出时间' and
                    re.match(r'\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}', date) and
                    len(name) > 1):
                    performances.append({
                        'name': name,
                        'date': date
                    })
    else:
        # 如果没有表格，尝试从页面文本中解析
        page_text = await page.locator('body').inner_text()
        lines = page_text.split('\n')
        
        for i, line in enumerate(lines):
            line = line.strip()
            # 跳过表头和空行
            if not line or line in ['演出名称', '演出时间', '演出名称\t演出时间']:
                continue
                
            # 查找包含日期格式的行 - 处理制表符分隔的格式
            if '\t' in line and re.search(r'\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}', line):
                parts = line.split('\t')
                if len(parts) >= 2:
                    name = parts[0].strip()
                    date = parts[1].strip()
                    
                    # 验证日期格式和名称
                    if re.match(r'\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}', date) and name and len(name) > 1:
                        performances.append({
                            'name': name,
                            'date': date
                        })
    
    return performances

# 执行主函数
async def main():
    result = await get_chongqing_foreign_performances_next_week()
    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("🎉 最终答案:")
    print("="*60)
    print(result)
    return result

# 运行
result = asyncio.run(main())
print(f"返回结果: {result}")

def parse_performances_final(markdown_content):
    """
    最终版本的演出信息解析函数
    """
    performances = []
    lines = markdown_content.split('\n')
    
    i = 0
    while i < len(lines):
        line = lines[i].strip()
        
        # 查找演出时间行
        if "演出时间：" in line:
            time_info = line.replace("演出时间：", "").strip()
            
            # 向前查找标题，寻找包含演出名称的行
            title = ""
            for j in range(max(0, i-10), i):
                prev_line = lines[j].strip()
                # 查找包含演出相关关键词的链接行
                if (prev_line.startswith('[') and '](' in prev_line and 
                    ('京剧' in prev_line or '昆曲' in prev_line or '戏曲' in prev_line or 
                     '演出' in prev_line or '剧院' in prev_line or '展演' in prev_line)):
                    title_match = re.match(r'\[(.*?)\]', prev_line)
                    if title_match:
                        potential_title = title_match.group(1)
                        # 确保不是"查看更多"这样的链接
                        if len(potential_title) > 10 and '查看更多' not in potential_title:
                            title = potential_title
                            print(f"   找到标题: {title[:50]}...")
                            break
            
            # 如果没找到合适的标题，再次尝试查找
            if not title:
                for j in range(max(0, i-15), i):
                    prev_line = lines[j].strip()
                    if prev_line.startswith('[') and '](' in prev_line:
                        title_match = re.match(r'\[(.*?)\]', prev_line)
                        if title_match:
                            potential_title = title_match.group(1)
                            if len(potential_title) > 5 and '查看更多' not in potential_title:
                                title = potential_title
                                print(f"   备选标题: {title[:50]}...")
                                break
            
            # 向后查找地点和票价信息
            venue_info = ""
            price_info = ""
            for j in range(i+1, min(i+5, len(lines))):
                next_line = lines[j].strip()
                if "演出地点：" in next_line:
                    venue_info = next_line.replace("演出地点：", "").strip()
                elif "演出票价：" in next_line:
                    price_info = next_line.replace("演出票价：", "").strip()
            
            if time_info:  # 至少要有时间信息
                if not title:
                    title = "演出信息"  # 默认标题
                
                performances.append({
                    'title': title,
                    'time': time_info,
                    'venue': venue_info,
                    'price': price_info,
                    'date': time_info  # 用于日期匹配
                })
        
        i += 1
    
    return performances
